primerosPasos.repetirAyuda: Choose your language again, create an identity and a habit, and see how to install Pepita. Nothing gets deleted.

idioma.titulo: Hi! I'm Pepita. Which language shall we use?
idioma.ayuda: I'm suggesting your browser's language; you can change it any time. No accounts: everything stays on this device.
idioma.copia: Have a backup? Restore it in Settings

identidad.titulo: Who do you want to be?
identidad.ayuda: Write it as a sentence: “I am a person who…”. Each habit will be a vote for that person.

registrar.ayuda: Do your minimum version and tap it: that's your first vote. If you can't right now, that's fine.

instalar.ayuda: Installed on your home screen, it opens instantly and takes better care of your data.
instalar.menu: If your browser allows it, add it to your home screen from its menu.
instalar.yaInstalada: You already have Pepita installed. Great!

ios.titulo: How to install it on your iPhone or iPad
ios.compartir: In Safari, tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
ios.anadir: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap “Add”.
ios.abrir: From now on, open Pepita from its icon.
ios.porque: Safari may delete data from websites you haven't opened in a few weeks. Once installed, Pepita keeps it.

hoy.vacio: No habits yet. Start with a small one: that's enough.
hoy.notaEjemplo: Anything you want to remember about today?

identidades.intro: Every time you do a habit, you cast a vote for who you want to be.
identidades.ayuda: Write it as a sentence: “I am someone who…”.
identidades.archivadasAyuda: They keep their habits and votes. Their habits stay out of Today until you bring them back.
identidades.delHabito: Who are you voting for with this habit?
identidades.filtroVacio: No habits for this identity today. You can add one if you like.

frecuencia.veces_por_periodo: A few times a day, week or month

ajustes.hora_cierre_ayuda: Anything you do before {{hora}} counts for the day before, so a late night still counts.

copias.intro: Everything lives only on this device. A backup now and then keeps it safe.
copias.ninguna: You haven't made a backup yet.
copias.importarAyuda: Choose a Pepita JSON file. We'll ask before changing anything.
copias.exportada: Backup saved. Your data is safe.
copias.importada: Done: your data has been restored.
copias.confirmarTitulo: Replace your data with this backup?
copias.confirmarTexto: The backup has {{habitos}} and {{registros}}. It will replace everything currently on this device.
copias.intactos: Your data is just as it was.

error.no_es_json: This file doesn't look like a Pepita backup.
error.no_es_pepita: This file doesn't look like a Pepita backup.
error.version_nueva: This backup comes from a newer version of Pepita. Update the app and try again.
error.invalido: This backup is damaged and can't be used (problem at “{{ruta}}”).

copias.aviso: It's been over a week since your last backup. Shall we save one? It only takes a moment.
copias.persistenteSi: Your browser will keep your data even if it runs low on space.
copias.persistenteNo: Your browser might delete your data if it runs out of space. Backups keep you covered.
copias.persistenteNoDisponible: This browser can't be asked for persistent storage. Backups keep you covered.

nombre.titulo: What do you want to do?
nombre.ayuda: Something small and easy to start works best. This is the only must; the rest can wait.

identidad.titulo: Who are you voting for with this habit?
identidad.ayuda: Every time you do it, you cast a vote for the person you want to be.

frecuencia.ayuda: It doesn’t have to be daily. Pick a pace you can keep.

versiones.ayuda: The minimum fits in 2 minutes and counts just like the full one. On hard days, showing up is enough.

intencion.ayuda: Deciding when and where you will do it means starting doesn’t depend on feeling like it.

entorno.ayuda: Keep what you need in sight. The easier it is to start, the better.
entorno.ejemplo: For example: leave the book on the pillow

recompensa.ayuda: Pair the habit with something you enjoy and you’ll look forward to it.
recompensa.ejemplo: For example: I only listen to my podcast while walking

habito.archivarAyuda: Archiving takes it off Today and keeps its history and votes. You can bring it back any time.
habito.borrarTexto_one: Its check-in and its vote will be deleted too. This can’t be undone. If you just want to set it aside, archive it.
habito.borrarTexto_other: Its {{count}} check-ins and their votes will be deleted too. This can’t be undone. If you just want to set it aside, archive it.
habito.ayuda: Tap any day to log it, fix it or undo it. Everything updates on its own.
habito.sinRegistros: Nothing logged. If you forgot, you can log it now.
habito.frecuenciaAyuda: It applies from the current period. Anything already closed still counts with the rule you had then, so your history stays true.

archivados.intro: They rest here with their history. Their votes still count.

pausas.motivoEjemplo: For example: I have a fever
pausas.saltarAyuda: Skipping adds nothing and takes nothing away: it's a rest with permission.
pausas.saltadoAviso: Done, you skipped it. It doesn't count as a miss.
pausas.pausadoAviso: Paused until {{fecha}}. Those days don't count as a miss.
pausas.reanudado: Welcome back! It counts again from today.

global.intro: Pause all your habits until a date. Those days don't count as a miss, and the pause ends on its own.
global.activa: You're on holiday until {{fecha}}. Your habits will wait, no rush.
global.terminada: Hello again! Your habits count again from today.
global.aviso: On holiday until {{fecha}}. None of this counts as a miss.

recuperacion.sugerencia: Time to come back. The minimum version is enough.
recuperacion.rachaAyuda: Counts the periods you completed. A single miss doesn't break it.
recuperacion.anotar: What happened? (if you'd like to say)
recuperacion.anotarAyuda: No blame: it just helps to understand what the habit needs.

leyes.1: I didn't notice it (1st law: make it obvious)
leyes.2: I didn't feel like it (2nd law: make it attractive)
leyes.3: It was hard (3rd law: make it easy)
leyes.4: It didn't feel worth it (4th law: make it satisfying)

detalleIdentidad.sinVotos: No votes yet. The first one arrives when you do a habit for this identity.
detalleIdentidad.sinHabitos: This identity has no habits yet.
detalleIdentidad.noExiste: I can't find this identity. Maybe it came from an older backup.

hitos.todos: You've reached every milestone. Every vote still counts.
hitos.celebracionIdentidad: Look how many times you voted for “{{identidad}}”. That person is already you.
